headline: Tail 17% as NQZ26 reaches 31,224.50, up 0.52%, with a 114.50-point retracement to 31,115.00 bought back and the 14:20Z bar clearing the prior high by only 8.00 points
body:
The prior hour published Tail at 11% with NQZ26 coiling near 31,027.75 and the 09:40Z session low of 30,957.50 successfully retested at 30,965.00. That coil resolved upward. From the 13:25Z bar low of 31,007.75 the index ran 221.75 points in twenty minutes: the 13:30Z US cash open printed a genuine continuation bar from 31,044.25 to 31,160.00, and the 13:45Z bar extended to 31,229.50.

What happened next is the decisive evidence. The 13:45Z and 14:00Z bars gave back 114.50 points to 31,115.00, roughly 52% of the entire impulse, inside fifteen minutes. That retracement held, price recovered through 31,214.75 in the 14:15Z bar, and the 14:20Z bar set a new session high of 31,237.50. The last verified print is 31,224.50 at 14:24:47Z, up 162.75 points or 0.52% on the 31,061.75 prior close, with a 280.00-point day range.

Tail therefore rises from 11% to 17%. Three observations earn the increase: an observed opening-auction continuation, price holding at the session extreme, and a break of the prior high after a retracement. Two considerations cap it well below the blocking band. The retracement was 52% deep and was completed in fifteen minutes, which is the opposite of the shallow-pullback structure that defines a Tail path, and the new high clears the old one by only 8.00 points, which is a marginal break rather than repeated extension after a failed retracement.

The cross-asset picture conflicts rather than aligns, which is the other reason Tail stays in the low band. The VIX is up 2.09% to 15.63 while the index rallies. The Dow is down about 0.2% against a Nasdaq Composite up about 0.7%, so leadership is narrow. The 10-year yield rose roughly 4.5 basis points to 5.30% into an equity advance. Conflicting signals of this kind raise Stress and lower directional conviction; they are not Tail amplifiers.

The September ISM Services report, verified against the ISM release itself and against the Trading Economics calendar entry, printed 54.9 against 55.4 in August, a 27th consecutive month of expansion. Business activity fell sharply to 56.5 from 61.7, new orders eased to 59.8 from 60.9, employment returned to expansion at 50.1 from 47.8, and the prices index climbed to 74.0 from 72.6. A softer headline with a firmer employment component and renewed cost pressure is an ambiguous print, consistent with the two-way reaction actually observed rather than with one-way repricing.

Stress rises from 50% to 55%. The US 10-year near 5.30% is around its highest since 2007, Brent holds above $100 on Middle East supply risk while WTI eased about 1.6% to $89.70, the euro slid about 1.6% to a 17-month low as French budget gridlock pushed the OAT-Bund spread to roughly 145 basis points, its widest since the 2011 sovereign crisis, and the ISM prices index at 74.0 signals persistent services inflation. That is a genuinely difficult environment. It is also one in which a 52% retracement was bought back within fifteen minutes, which is exactly the configuration where high Stress coexists with Tail well below the blocking band.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 hours to 13:00Z, published Claude Tail ranged from 3% to 15% and the mapped state stayed EA_ON and green throughout. Tail sat at 3% through the whole of Monday's US cash session on 4 October, lifted into the 12% to 15% band overnight between 22:00Z and 01:00Z as the Asian session repriced, then decayed back to 6% by 08:00Z. The European morning produced a 14% print at 10:00Z on a brief trend-down phase, which reverted to 9% and then 7% as the move failed. The 13:00Z hour published 11% in a mixed mode after the 30,965.00 retest of the session low held. One hour, 06:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable rather than filled in. Stress declined steadily from a 71% peak at 21:00Z to 46% at 12:00Z before turning back up to 50%, and Confidence held in a tight 85% to 89% band throughout.
outlookSummary: Published Tail peaks at 18% in the 15:00Z hour, the second US cash hour, where decisive extension beyond the 31,237.50 session high on pullbacks shallower than the 114.50 points already observed would be the first genuine evidence of persistent directional efficiency. From there the modelled path eases through the US midday to 12% at 18:00Z, lifts to 15% across the 20:00Z cash close and power-hour imbalance window, then decays to a 9% overnight floor between 02:00Z and 05:00Z as Asian liquidity thins. The European open at 07:00Z carries it back to 11%, and the final two hours rise to 13% and 15% for the 12:15Z weekly ADP series, the 12:30Z August trade balance, the 13:05Z Williams speech and the 13:30Z US cash open. Every one of the 24 slots stays inside the low Tail band, so the mapped state is EA_ON and green across the full horizon. Stress tracks between 46% and 55%, remaining elevated for most of the horizon on the yield, energy and European political backdrop, and Confidence decays from 87% to 75% purely with distance from verified observation rather than because the evidence conflicts.
